purpose: Make the physical volume/coefficient/owner choices explicit; prevent source DEC or native occupied-grid weights from becoming physical extracellular volumes, or geometry generation provenance from being lost
physical_contract: Complete original/retained/removed initial seed ledger and all native generation inputs/RNG/source/runtime pins; full MeshSpec/GridSpec/GeometrySpec; every physical cell/exterior inventory, fixed background and charge anchor; positive physical exterior m3; explicit height, per-membrane thickness and specific capacitance, membrane diffusion, one declared P/junction per reciprocal contact, faces, reservoir/gauge closure, all controls and execution
unit_derivation: Geometry lengths m; patch area=edge length*height in m2
Cell physical volume chooses native radial patch sum or polygon area*height in m3; output pL=m3*1e15
Exterior volume is caller-declared physical m3 only; DEC and native weighted measures remain geometric diagnostics
Membrane C[F]=bound area[m2]*explicit areal C[F/m2]; P[m/s]=explicit D[m2/s]/explicit thickness[m]
Junction P[m/s] is explicit and its single contact surface comes from the named reciprocal membrane pair; no GJ fraction/distance inferred
fmol/pL=mol/m3; no concentration/inventory rescaling or fixed-background/charge inference
reference: Independent stdlib explicit-polygon measures and raw owner mappings; existing frozen full-node field, Decimal GHK, owner sums, charge/current and energy references
scope_limits: Initial static ordinary passive tissue only; no biological amount exists on an initially removed seed
No geometry generation rerun or cross-generation coordinate matching
No physical state/charge remap, cut epoch, moving geometry or solver/checkpoint continuation
No inferred GJ/exterior transport, membrane thickness/capacitance, reservoir/gauge or missing physical inventories
No full native simulator, DEC continuum, GPU or integrated/compiled trajectory claim
Qualified existing modules, shared dispatch/CLI/PROGRESS and active/detached jobs untouched
Ordinary tissue IDs require ASCII letters/digits/underscore/hyphen; incompatible source owner IDs refused, with no implicit remapping
refused_native_cases: native-single-preset-seed17: original source cell IDs contain colons; no implicit renaming
